gaja_kesari_yoga.what: Jupiter, the planet of wisdom, stands in a strong place from your Moon, the planet of the mind.
gaja_kesari_yoga.formed_when: Jupiter in the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th place counted from your Moon.
gaja_kesari_yoga.impact: Often read as a steady mind, good sense, and respect from people around you. It is one support, not a promise of fame. It shows most in Jupiter's periods.
do: Share what you know: teach, guide, advise.
Keep your promises. Your word is your strength.
Thursday prayer to Guru or Dakshinamurthy, if it suits you.

chandra_mangal_yoga.what: Your Moon (the mind) and Mars (energy and drive) are joined.
chandra_mangal_yoga.formed_when: Moon and Mars in the same sign, or facing each other seven signs apart.
chandra_mangal_yoga.impact: Often read as a strong drive to earn and quick, strong feelings. Good for business and hard work. Feelings can run hot.
do: Put your energy into work with clear results, like sales or your own business.
Take a short walk before you reply when angry.
Tuesday prayer to Hanuman, if it suits you.
avoid: Money decisions when you are upset.
Arguments over small things at home.

budhaditya_yoga.what: The Sun (self and authority) and Mercury (thinking and speech) sit together.
budhaditya_yoga.formed_when: Sun and Mercury in the same sign.
budhaditya_yoga.impact: Often read as a sharp mind and clear speech, useful in studies, office work and dealing with seniors. It is very common, so it adds colour rather than deciding things.
do: Use writing and speaking in your work.
Prepare well before exams and interviews.
Wednesday prayer to Vishnu, if it suits you.
avoid: Talking over others to prove a point.

kemadruma_yoga.what: Your Moon, the planet of the mind, has no planet beside it or around it. Old texts read this as a mind that has to stand on its own.
kemadruma_yoga.formed_when: No planet in the sign before or after the Moon, none with it, none in the 4th, 7th or 10th from it, and none in a pillar house (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) from your rising sign.
kemadruma_yoga.impact: You may feel you carry worries alone, or that help comes late. It is a flag, not a verdict, and it does not mean poverty or bad luck. Most charts that start with it are cancelled by the rules above.
do: Keep one or two people you talk to every week.
Fix a daily time for sleep and meals.
Monday prayer to Shiva or Parvati, if it suits you.
avoid: Shutting yourself away when things are hard.
Big decisions after a sleepless night.

neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga.what: One of your planets is in its weakest sign, and something else in your chart repairs that weakness.
neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga.formed_when: A planet in its weakest sign, plus at least one classical repair: the lord of that sign, the planet strong in that sign, or the lord of the planet's best sign in a pillar house (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) from your rising sign or Moon; those two lords in pillar places from each other; the sign's lord looking at the planet; or the planet itself in a pillar house.
neecha_bhanga_raja_yoga.impact: The usual reading is a slow or hard start in that planet's area of life, then real strength later. Effort counts more than luck here. Two or more repairs make it stronger.
do: Be patient with early setbacks in this area.
Keep learning. The repair often comes through skill.
A weekly prayer on that planet's day, if it suits you.
avoid: Giving up after the first try.

raja_yoga.what: Planets that rule your chart's strongest houses are linked: one rules a pillar house, the other a luck house.
raja_yoga.formed_when: The lord of a pillar house (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) and the lord of a luck house (1st, 5th, 9th) sit together, look at each other, or sit in each other's signs.
raja_yoga.impact: Read as support for position, respect and progress at work. It shows most when these planets run their periods. Most charts have at least one, so it is a support, not a promise of power.
do: Take responsibility when it is offered.
Grow your career with steady effort.
Respect elders and teachers.
raja_yoga.how_common: Most charts have at least one (about 9 in 10).

dhana_yoga.what: Planets that rule your money houses are linked.
dhana_yoga.formed_when: The lords of the 2nd, 5th, 9th or 11th houses sit together, look at each other, or sit in each other's signs.
dhana_yoga.impact: Read as support for earning and saving. It shows most in the periods of these planets. It is common, so it is a support, not a forecast of riches.
do: Save a fixed part of every income.
Learn the basics of money: budgets, EMIs, savings.
Give to charity within your means.

ruchaka_yoga.what: Mars is very strong in your chart: in its own or best sign, in a pillar place.
ruchaka_yoga.formed_when: Mars in Aries, Scorpio or Capricorn, in the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th place from your rising sign or your Moon.
ruchaka_yoga.impact: One of the five great-person yogas. Read as courage, physical energy, and the ability to lead and protect. Good for police, defence, sport, engineering and property.
do: Regular exercise or sport.
Take on tasks that need courage.
Tuesday prayer to Hanuman, if it suits you.

bhadra_yoga.what: Mercury is very strong in your chart: in its own or best sign, in a pillar place.
bhadra_yoga.formed_when: Mercury in Gemini or Virgo, in the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th place from your rising sign or your Moon.
bhadra_yoga.impact: One of the five great-person yogas. Read as a sharp mind, good speech, and skill with numbers, trade and writing.
do: Build skills in writing, accounts, teaching or trade.
Keep learning new things.
Wednesday prayer to Vishnu, if it suits you.

hamsa_yoga.what: Jupiter is very strong in your chart: in its own or best sign, in a pillar place.
hamsa_yoga.formed_when: Jupiter in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer, in the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th place from your rising sign or your Moon.
hamsa_yoga.impact: One of the five great-person yogas. Read as wisdom, good values, respect from others, and a pull towards learning and dharma.
do: Teach or guide others.
Keep to your values in money matters.
Thursday prayer to Guru, if it suits you.
avoid: Too much rich food and comfort.

malavya_yoga.what: Venus is very strong in your chart: in its own or best sign, in a pillar place.
malavya_yoga.formed_when: Venus in Taurus, Libra or Pisces, in the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th place from your rising sign or your Moon.
malavya_yoga.impact: One of the five great-person yogas. Read as comfort, good taste, art, a happy family life and good vehicles.
do: Make time for music, art or design.
Keep your home neat and welcoming.
Friday prayer to Lakshmi, if it suits you.

sasa_yoga.what: Saturn is very strong in your chart: in its own or best sign, in a pillar place.
sasa_yoga.formed_when: Saturn in Capricorn, Aquarius or Libra, in the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th place from your rising sign or your Moon.
sasa_yoga.impact: One of the five great-person yogas. Read as discipline, patience, and authority that grows with age. Often leads people or works with large groups.
do: Keep steady routines.
Treat workers and helpers fairly.
Saturday prayer to Shani or Hanuman, if it suits you.
avoid: Cutting corners when rules feel slow.

viparita_raja_yoga.what: A planet that rules a hard house sits in another hard house. One difficulty cancels another.
viparita_raja_yoga.formed_when: The lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th house sits in the 6th, 8th or 12th house.
viparita_raja_yoga.impact: Read as gains that come after a problem, often unexpectedly. People with it tend to recover well from setbacks.
do: Stay calm in a crisis. Your best work comes then.
Keep some money aside for surprises.
avoid: Creating problems just to solve them.

sunapha_yoga.what: A planet sits in the sign just after your Moon, so your mind has support.
sunapha_yoga.formed_when: Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn in the 2nd sign from the Moon.
sunapha_yoga.impact: Read as self-earned money, good sense and a good name. The planet that forms it gives the flavour: Mars bold, Mercury clever, Jupiter learned, Venus refined, Saturn hard-working.
do: Build your own income step by step.
Use the strengths of the planet that forms it.
avoid: Depending only on others for money.

anapha_yoga.what: A planet sits in the sign just before your Moon, so your mind has support.
anapha_yoga.formed_when: Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn in the 12th sign from the Moon.
anapha_yoga.impact: Read as good health, good manners, contentment and a good name.
do: Keep a simple, clean daily routine.
Dress and speak well. It helps you.

durudhara_yoga.what: Planets sit on both sides of your Moon, so your mind has support from both sides.
durudhara_yoga.formed_when: Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn in both the sign before and the sign after the Moon.
durudhara_yoga.impact: Read as comfort, money, generosity and good people around you.
do: Share with others. Charity suits you.
Keep good company.

vesi_yoga.what: A good planet (Mercury, Jupiter or Venus) sits in the sign just after your Sun.
vesi_yoga.formed_when: Mercury, Jupiter or Venus in the 2nd sign from the Sun.
vesi_yoga.impact: Read as a balanced nature, truthful speech and steady work, with support in public life.
do: Speak honestly at work.
Build your good name slowly.
Sunday prayer to Surya, if it suits you.
avoid: Promising more than you can do.

vosi_yoga.what: A good planet (Mercury, Jupiter or Venus) sits in the sign just before your Sun.
vosi_yoga.formed_when: Mercury, Jupiter or Venus in the 12th sign from the Sun.
vosi_yoga.impact: Read as skill, learning and a good memory, with support that works quietly behind the scenes.
do: Keep learning new skills.
Help others without fuss.
avoid: Hiding your work so others take the credit.

ubhayachari_yoga.what: Good planets (Mercury, Jupiter or Venus) sit on both sides of your Sun.
ubhayachari_yoga.formed_when: Mercury, Jupiter or Venus in both the sign before and the sign after the Sun.
ubhayachari_yoga.impact: Read as a balanced life, good speech, and respect from people in authority.
do: Take on roles that need trust.
Keep your promises.

asubha_vesi_yoga.what: Mars or Saturn sits in the sign just after your Sun. The old books call this the hard form of Vesi.
asubha_vesi_yoga.formed_when: Mars or Saturn in the 2nd sign from the Sun.
asubha_vesi_yoga.impact: Read as effort before reward and a blunt way of speaking. Respect comes, but slowly. It is not a bad-luck sign.
do: Choose your words carefully at work.
Finish what you start, even if slowly.

asubha_vosi_yoga.what: Mars or Saturn sits in the sign just before your Sun. The old books call this the hard form of Vosi.
asubha_vosi_yoga.formed_when: Mars or Saturn in the 12th sign from the Sun.
asubha_vosi_yoga.impact: Read as effort before reward. Respect comes late and is earned. It is not a bad-luck sign.
do: Finish what you start, even if slowly.
Keep your records and papers clean.

asubha_ubhayachari_yoga.what: Mars or Saturn sit on both sides of your Sun. The old books call this the hard form of Ubhayachari.
asubha_ubhayachari_yoga.formed_when: Mars or Saturn in both the sign before and the sign after the Sun.
asubha_ubhayachari_yoga.impact: Read as a life with more effort and more pressure from outside. Patience and good habits balance it. It is a flag, not a verdict.
do: Keep a calm daily routine.
Stay with honest work and honest people.
Saturday prayer to Hanuman, if it suits you.

adhi_yoga.what: Good planets (Mercury, Jupiter or Venus) sit in the 6th, 7th and 8th places from your Moon.
adhi_yoga.formed_when: Mercury, Jupiter or Venus in at least two of the 6th, 7th and 8th signs from the Moon.
adhi_yoga.impact: Read as leadership, a trusted position, good health and good people around you.
do: Take up roles where you lead or manage.
Keep good, honest friends.

amala_yoga.what: A good planet (Mercury, Jupiter or Venus) sits in your career place, the 10th from your rising sign or your Moon.
amala_yoga.formed_when: Mercury, Jupiter or Venus in the 10th sign from your rising sign or from your Moon.
amala_yoga.impact: Read as a clean name, good conduct and respect at work.
do: Keep your work honest and on time.
Help people at work when you can.
avoid: Shortcuts that could harm your name.

saraswati_yoga.what: Jupiter, Venus and Mercury, the three planets of learning, all sit in good houses, and Jupiter is comfortable.
saraswati_yoga.formed_when: Jupiter, Venus and Mercury each in the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th or 10th house, with Jupiter in its own, best or a friendly sign.
saraswati_yoga.impact: Read as a love of learning and skill in speech, writing, music or the arts.
do: Study every day, even a little.
Write, teach, sing or speak.
Prayer to Saraswati, if it suits you.

shubha_kartari_yoga.what: Your rising sign or your Moon has good planets on both sides and no hard ones.
shubha_kartari_yoga.formed_when: Mercury, Jupiter or Venus in both the sign before and the sign after your rising sign (or Moon), with no Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu there.
shubha_kartari_yoga.impact: Read as protection: good health, few enemies, and a sense that things work out.
do: Use the calm years to build.
Be grateful and help others.

papa_kartari_yoga.what: Your rising sign or your Moon has hard planets (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu or Ketu) on both sides, with no good planet between.
papa_kartari_yoga.formed_when: Hard planets in both the sign before and the sign after your rising sign (or Moon), and no Mercury, Jupiter or Venus there.
papa_kartari_yoga.impact: Read as feeling pressed from both sides at times. It is a flag, not a verdict: good planets elsewhere and good periods balance it.
do: Keep a daily routine that steadies you.
Ask for help early when pressure builds.
Prayer to Durga or Hanuman, if it suits you.
avoid: Taking on too much at once.

shakata_yoga.what: Your Moon sits 6th, 8th or 12th from Jupiter. The old name means cart wheel: luck goes up and down.
shakata_yoga.formed_when: Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th sign counted from Jupiter. Cancelled when the Moon sits in a pillar house (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) from your rising sign.
shakata_yoga.impact: Read as ups and downs in luck and money, and rebuilding after a dip. It is a flag, not a verdict.
do: Save in good months for slow ones.
Keep steady work even when luck is high.
Thursday prayer to Guru, if it suits you.
avoid: Big risks after a lucky run.

guru_chandala_yoga.what: Jupiter (wisdom and teachers) sits with Rahu or Ketu (the two shadow points).
guru_chandala_yoga.formed_when: Jupiter in the same sign as Rahu (main form) or Ketu (milder form).
guru_chandala_yoga.impact: Read as an unusual view of tradition and teachers: questioning old rules, or learning from unusual sources. Advice from guides can be mixed.
do: Check advice before acting on it.
Respect teachers even when you disagree.
Thursday prayer to Guru, if it suits you.

kalasarpa_flag.what: All seven planets sit on one side of Rahu and Ketu.
kalasarpa_flag.formed_when: Every planet from the Sun to Saturn falls between Rahu and Ketu on one side of the chart. A planet in the same sign as Rahu or Ketu breaks it.
kalasarpa_flag.impact: This is a modern idea. It is not in the main old books such as BPHS or Phaladeepika. Some read it as effort and delay before results. Treat it lightly.
do: Be steady and patient with long goals.
Prayer to Shiva or Naga devata, if it suits you.
avoid: Fear from what others say about it.

rajju_yoga.what: All seven planets sit in moving signs.
rajju_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn all in Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn.
rajju_yoga.impact: Read as a love of travel and change, and work that keeps you moving.
do: Choose work with travel or variety.
avoid: Changing jobs often without a plan.

musala_yoga.what: All seven planets sit in fixed signs.
musala_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn all in Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius.
musala_yoga.impact: Read as a firm will, steady work, and pride in what you build.
do: Commit to long projects.

nala_yoga.what: All seven planets sit in dual signs.
nala_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn all in Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces.
nala_yoga.impact: Read as adaptable and skilful in many things.
do: Use your many skills, but finish one thing at a time.

mala_yoga.what: Mercury, Venus and Jupiter, the three good planets, each sit in a pillar house of your chart.
mala_yoga.formed_when: Mercury, Venus and Jupiter each in the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house.
mala_yoga.impact: Read as comfort, good things and a pleasant life.
do: Share your comforts with others.

sarpa_yoga.what: The Sun, Mars and Saturn each sit in a pillar house of your chart. The old books list this as a caution.
sarpa_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Mars and Saturn each in the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house.
sarpa_yoga.impact: Read as a life that needs more effort and firmness. It is a flag, not a verdict.
do: Keep firm but kind habits.
Prayer to Hanuman, if it suits you.

gola_yoga.what: Your seven planets are spread across one sign.
gola_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn spread across exactly one sign.
gola_yoga.impact: All planets in one sign: life tends to focus very strongly on one area. The old books read it as harder for money; good habits balance it.
do: Widen your interests and friendships.
avoid: Putting all your money in one place.

yuga_yoga.what: Your seven planets are spread across two signs.
yuga_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn spread across exactly two signs.
yuga_yoga.impact: Read as a narrow focus. Money and beliefs may need care.
do: Build savings slowly.

shoola_yoga.what: Your seven planets are spread across three signs.
shoola_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn spread across exactly three signs.
shoola_yoga.impact: Read as sharp and quick to anger, with money needing care.
do: Put your energy into work and sport.

kedara_yoga.what: Your seven planets are spread across four signs.
kedara_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn spread across exactly four signs.
kedara_yoga.impact: Named after a farmer: read as useful, hard-working, and gaining through land or steady work.
do: Steady work, and long-term savings.

pasa_yoga.what: Your seven planets are spread across five signs.
pasa_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn spread across exactly five signs.
pasa_yoga.impact: Pasa means rope: read as a busy life with many ties, skill in work and many people around you.
do: Keep your commitments manageable.
avoid: Getting tied up in other people's disputes.

dama_yoga.what: Your seven planets are spread across six signs.
dama_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn spread across exactly six signs.
dama_yoga.impact: Dama means garland: read as generous, helpful and respected.
do: Help others. It suits you.

veena_yoga.what: Your seven planets are spread across seven signs.
veena_yoga.formed_when: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn spread across exactly seven signs.
veena_yoga.impact: Like the seven strings of a veena: read as a love of music and art, many friends and good fortune.
do: Make time for music or art.

sankhya_yoga.what: How many signs your seven planets spread across.
sankhya_yoga.formed_when: Counted from the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn.
sankhya_yoga.impact: A background pattern with a light effect.
sankhya_yoga.how_common: Every chart has one of these.

manglik_dosha.what: A marriage-matching check on where Mars (energy and drive) sits. Families check it before matching horoscopes.
manglik_dosha.formed_when: Mars in the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th place counted from your rising sign, your Moon or Venus. Regions differ on which points and houses count.
manglik_dosha.impact: Read as strong energy in married life: you and your partner may both need space and patience. It is a flag, not a verdict. Most charts have it from at least one point, and many cancellations apply. It does not stop or spoil a marriage on its own.
do: Match with care, looking at the whole chart, not this one flag.
Talk openly with your partner about anger and space.
Tuesday prayer to Hanuman or Subrahmanya, if it suits you.
avoid: Rejecting a match only because of this.
Taking fear from what relatives say.
manglik_dosha.how_common: About 9 in 10 charts from at least one point; about half from the rising sign alone.

gandanta_dosha.what: One of your key points (Moon, rising point or Sun) sits right where a water sign ends and a fire sign begins.
gandanta_dosha.formed_when: Within about 3 degrees of the Cancer to Leo, Scorpio to Sagittarius, or Pisces to Aries changeover.
gandanta_dosha.impact: Old texts read this as a knot where one thing ends and the next begins, so changes may come suddenly. It is a flag, not a verdict. Many people with it live ordinary, happy lives.
do: Give big changes time, and settle in slowly.
Keep a short daily prayer or quiet time.
Prayer to Ganesha, if it suits you.

grahan_dosha.what: Your Sun or Moon sits with Rahu or Ketu, the two eclipse points.
grahan_dosha.formed_when: Sun or Moon in the same sign as Rahu or Ketu. Closer than 5 degrees counts as strong.
grahan_dosha.impact: Read as times when confidence (Sun) or peace of mind (Moon) feels clouded. It is a flag, not a verdict.
do: Keep a steady daily routine.
Talk through worries with someone you trust.
Sunday prayer to Surya, or Monday prayer to Shiva, if it suits you.
avoid: Letting worry about it decide your plans.
